created_for: Prepare PPO resume from the official behavior-cloned policy; do not launch PPO until the BC student evaluation is reviewed.

student_evaluation.required_result_before_ppo: Review the explicitly authorized extended BC diagnostic and establish whether the default incomplete attempt reflects the evaluator lap deadline or a student route-following failure. No PPO until the student behavior and training action handling are understood.

simulator_and_track.official_competition_simulator_release: AutoDRIVE RoboRacer 2026 IROS competition Windows executable, verified against the official compete release

ppo_run_config_to_apply_after_student_ga.resume_behavior: Resume skips new teacher collection and transfers the saved actor weights into a fresh PPO optimizer and rollout buffer.
ppo_run_config_to_apply_after_student_ga.stop_policy: No timestep, plateau, or wall-clock stop; stop manually from Mission Control.
ppo_run_config_to_apply_after_student_ga.evaluation_protocol: One warm-up lap followed by ten scored official laps, repeated over three fresh attempts.

observations.camera: RGB uint8 90x160x3; feature extractor divides by 255 once; SB3 image normalization disabled

exploration.reason: The saved BC policy uses 0.2 for both action dimensions. On 256 held-out observations and 1000 draws per observation, that produced throttle below zero 46.4% of the time and throttle above the teacher's 0.035 maximum 46.6% of the time. A separate PPO warm-start candidate uses smaller per-action noise; it leaves deterministic actor outputs unchanged and must still be checked by the official student diagnostic.
exploration.schedule: Reduce by 10% after an improved valid ten-lap score; raise by 10% after three stale official evaluations, clamped to the range above.

episode_and_reward.collision_and_stall_behavior: Terminate and reset that training life; no reward clawback; collision/failure penalty exceeds the 120-point maximum shaped progress return.

preparation_checks.saved_checkpoint_load_and_inference: passed; finite two-dimensional action from camera, LiDAR, and state input

offline_heldout_validation_subset.split: indices 47838..48861, within behavior_clone_actor validation indices 43976..48861 and outside its training indices 0..43975
offline_heldout_validation_subset.limitation: Same teacher episode and sensor distribution; this measures imitation error, not student driving performance.

preparation_checks.checkpoint_to_fresh_ppo_resume: passed on original BC checkpoint; strict actor weight transfer, expected camera transpose, action std about 0.2

separate_ppo_warmstart_candidate.status: prepared; requires official evaluator diagnosis before PPO use
separate_ppo_warmstart_candidate.resume_and_rollout_start_smoke: passed; fresh PPO resume preserved camera transpose and the per-action scheduler kept [0.01, 0.05] at rollout start

preparation_checks.synthetic_ppo_optimizer_update: passed; one 64-step rollout/update on a synthetic environment only

limitations: The only official 10-lap result is the privileged route-aware teacher episode. The cloned sensor policy has not yet passed an official evaluation.
Checkpoint load, offline held-out imitation, and the synthetic PPO update do not prove official simulator behavior, wall avoidance under PPO exploration, or long-run stability.
One environment is selected because the successful BC collection and teacher validation used one official Windows simulator; parallel PPO speedup is not established by this preparation.
